core_obligations: Turn a strict sum-of-squared Calkin bounds into uniform lower bounds on a finite-codimension subspace.
Apply the source-local symmetric closed-range/Fredholm-pair criterion.
Deform one projection to a compact perturbation while controlling the Calkin distance and preserving Fredholmness to obtain index additivity.
proof_roadmap: Controlled projection homotopy and index calculation
difficulty_reason: The proof goes beyond a small operator-norm perturbation argument: it works modulo compact operators on a finite-codimension subspace and constructs a projection homotopy that controls the Calkin distance while reducing index additivity to compact differences. These are the substantive operator-theoretic steps behind the sharp APS stability applications.
